description: Benign and adversarial registrant metadata for evaluating the issue #1811 metadata scanner. Labels were assigned from the intent of each record before the scanner was run, and were not changed after seeing results. 'malicious' records try to instruct, poison or phish a model that reads the metadata; 'benign' records are realistic operational metadata, including ones that use words like ignore, token, key, password, credentials or instructions in a harmless way. 'malicious_keys' lists the key paths a correct attribution would flag. Records marked post_hoc were added after the first run to test one mechanism (JSON escaping of newlines) and are excluded from the headline metrics.
